_about: Hand-curated judgement fields that cannot be derived from the transcript: phase goal, human intervention, validation, outcome and rework. Everything else in ai-log.jsonl is generated by tools/build_ai_log.py from the Claude Code transcript and git. 'by' says who acted: 'user' = the human participant, 'orchestrator' = the main Claude Code agent checking sub-agent or its own output. Entries marked pending are for the participant to complete; nothing here is claimed on the participant's behalf.

human_review.notes: Participant: read the PR diff and ASSIGNMENT.md, then set status to 'done', add your name/date and any changes you made by hand. Re-run tools/build_ai_log.py afterwards.

phases.title: Discovery and toolchain setup
phases.goal: Understand the repo, establish a baseline (tests, mutation score) and the tools the brief needs.

human_intervention.what: Gave the assignment brief, forked and cloned the repo, and scoped the work: everything except the demo video.

validation: Baseline unit tests run (7 passed) before any change
Baseline Stryker run recorded on untouched main (30.77%)
phases.rework: .NET SDK was missing from the machine; installed .NET 8 user-locally (~/.dotnet) before anything could run.

phases.title: Context engineering: AGENTS.md, skills, sub-agent definitions, hooks
phases.goal: Give a cold agent the approval rules, layering, commands and review contract; make logging and commit format automatic.
validation: Commit-message hook smoke-tested with a good and a bad message (exit 0 / exit 2)
Logging hook confirmed live by the appearance of ai-interactions.jsonl
phases.rework: First commit-hook version crashed on malformed JSON input; hardened to fail open and to fix an operator-precedence bug, then retested.

phases.title: Specification with OpenSpec
phases.goal: Pin the five business rules down as SHALL requirements with boundary and negative scenarios before writing code.

human_intervention.what: Supplied the design decisions to the spec-writer (inclusive limits, Manager may give first of two approvals, Admin cannot approve, 403 mapping).
Read the generated spec and tasks before committing; confirmed boundary, casing and nothing-changes scenarios were present.

phases.title: Step 1: single-approver limits (Manager 50,000 / Director 500,000)
markers: Add approval policy and wire into service
phases.goal: Land the role limits with tests as their own commit.

human_intervention.what: Broke the rules on purpose (mutate-before-check, > to >=) to prove the tests can fail.
Caught its own mistake: a `git checkout` used to undo an experiment wiped the uncommitted ApprovalService change; restored it from the pre-experiment backup and switched to cp-based backup/restore.
Diagnosed a misleading smoke test: port 5000 was answered by macOS AirPlay (AirTunes), not the app; re-ran on port 5080.

validation: Experiment A (mutate before check): 2 tests red
curl smoke test: Manager 72,500 -> 403 with reason, invoice unchanged; Director -> 200 Approved
phases.rework: Experiment B first ran against a broken build (wiped file) and produced no result; re-run after restoring.

phases.title: Step 2: two distinct approvers above 500,000
phases.goal: Land the two-approver and same-user rules with tests as their own commit, done by a sub-agent and checked by the orchestrator.

human_intervention.what: Reviewed the implementer's full production diff line by line (validate-before-mutate order, trimmed case-insensitive comparison, purity of the policy) before committing.
Kept the commit scoped: staged backend + tasks only, leaving the parallel e2e work out.

validation: 56 unit tests passed on an independent re-run
Implementer's 9 break-it experiments each turned at least one test red

phases.title: Playwright end-to-end test: refused over-limit approval
markers: Write Playwright config, page objects, test
phases.goal: Prove the refusal reason reaches the user and the invoice visibly stays pending.

human_intervention.what: Moved the e2e server to port 5080 after finding AirPlay on 5000 would make reuseExistingServer test the wrong server.

validation: Raised ManagerLimit to 60,000 temporarily: e2e test failed, then restored

phases.title: Mutation testing and killing surviving mutants
phases.goal: Measure whether the tests can fail and close the gaps.

human_intervention.what: Triaged surviving mutants: killed the ones in approval logic, documented pre-existing ones (DiscountCalculator, message strings) as out of scope.

phases.title: Pull request and agent code review
markers: Push branch and open PR on fork
phases.goal: Open the PR and get an independent review with the workshop prompt.

human_intervention.what: Targeted the PR at the fork explicitly (--repo) so it would not open against upstream.

validation: code-reviewer returned 10 findings in the fixed F<n> format

phases.title: Judging review findings and fixing them
phases.goal: Give every finding a verdict (fixed / dismissed / deferred) and fix the real ones.

human_intervention.what: Verdicts: 8 fixed (F1a/b, F2, F3c, F4, F5, F7, F8, F9, F10), F6 + F1c + F3a/b deferred with tracked tasks, part of F9 dismissed with reason.
Wrote the race-condition test first and confirmed it fails without the fix before writing the fix.

validation: Concurrency tests red 5/5 runs without the lock, green with it
phases.rework: First concurrency test took 41 s (200 rounds x 50 ms barrier); trimmed to 25 rounds x 20 ms (2 s) and re-confirmed it still catches the bug.

phases.title: Write-up, AI logs, CI
phases.goal: Produce ASSIGNMENT.md, the PR description with verdicts, and the AI log; confirm CI.
validation: grep for emails/tokens in ai-logs: 0 matches
phases.rework: Logging hooks were only installed during P02, so the earlier steps were back-filled from the session transcript (tools/export_ai_transcript.py). Demo video link still pending (participant).

phases.title: Traceability log upgrade (log requirements from the course team)
phases.goal: Make the logs cover tool/model, agent type and mode, prompts, skills, MCP, actions, human intervention, evidence and outcome, generated automatically.

human_intervention.what: Supplied the nine logging requirements and asked for all of them to be met.

validation: ai-log.jsonl regenerated; every record has all nine sections

human_intervention.what: Reviewed spec.md and tasks.md before committing; no changes needed.
Reviewed the diff and re-ran the test suite independently; committed as-is.
Noted the sub-agent used the Playwright MCP browser to check the '1 of 2 approvals' label and cleaned up its .playwright-mcp folder; confirmed nothing outside its scope was touched.
Judged all 10 findings; agreed with most, deferred 4 sub-items and dismissed 1 with reasons.
